note: The shaper's trail (doc 13 'Trails'), read by src/world/trails.js and src/world/shaper.js, drawn on the journal's Trails page. A stop is the first time the island has a kind of place you made, noticed once (written in the saved unlocks' firsts with its hour) and never taken back, even if the place is filled in later. Each stop's need names its place; a stop marked built (stepping stones, in Sculpt's Pond stones mode, Steps, Sculpt's Steps mode, and the lantern, made at the workbench, B2 L1) inks when its place is made and its mode is offered from then on, and its gift (title and line) shows as a quiet card that opens this trail when the place is made while you play; the others are not built yet, so each shows in pencil, 'one day', after its place, and the next place ahead shows in pencil with its hint. Steps cut into a cliff replace the bench (the walker plan, October 21, 2026). check: how each place is noticed, from what the game already computes, looked at when the water settles after an edit and once a game hour: deepPoolMm, a pond's standing depth (the water summary's targetMm); a pond you made with no fish is the dragonflies' own test (a mostly shallow pond with a shaped, planted margin and no fish: ecology pools' fit); shapedCm: a stream or a cove counts only where the ground was moved this much from the island as generated (so the island's own brook or coves never count); coveScore and coveCells, so many half-metre shore cells sheltered to that score out of 255 (the cove field); fallM, how far water must fall from a terrace (the falls pass's lips); streamCells, half-metre cells of running water (the water summary's class); flowerKinds, kinds of plant in flower at once; reedShare, how much of a pond's edge (land squares beside its water) has reeds, rushes or iris, and reedPondM2 how big that pond must be. words: the page's words and each place's name.

stops.title: Stepping stones
stops.line: Flat stones to cross the water on. In Sculpt, Pond stones.

gift.title: Stepping stones
gift.line: Your pool is deep enough to want a way across. Sculpt has Pond stones now: drag across the water to lay them.

stops.hint: a pond of your own, quiet, with no fish
stops.title: A lantern
stops.line: A small light that wakes at dusk. The workbench makes one.

gift.title: A lantern
gift.line: Your pond is quiet enough to want a light by it. Shape a lantern pot from clay and pebbles at the workbench, fire it, and set it on a post.

stops.title: Paths
stops.line: Draw one, and moss grows in later.

stops.title: Steps
stops.line: Steps cut into a cliff. In Sculpt, Steps.

gift.title: Steps
gift.line: Water falls from your terrace. Sculpt has Steps now: drag from the shelf down to the ground to climb it.

stops.title: Photo frames
stops.line: Frames for your pictures of the island.

stops.hint: five kinds in flower at once
stops.title: The island map
stops.line: With names you give the places.

stops.title: A wind chime
stops.line: It sings by the reeds when the wind comes.
